x: And so we come to what ordinary laymen like you and me, who are not supposed to be able to interpret rules, might think to be a parallel, but which in "higher" circles passes unnoticed. At the "Kinnaird" Meeting D. Finlay, the English 120 yards hurdles champion, represented, quite rightly, Surrey Athletic Club.
Eddie Short is now the Officer-in-charge of Athletics at the R.A.F. Halton Camp and his C/O is none other than the old Olympic hurdler, Don Finlay.

More important, the generation of pre-war stars that had carried on after the war such as Sydney Wooderson and Don Finlay were now being supplanted by a new generation of athletes, some of whom were only at the beginning of high calibre careers.
